units.source_text: “千重子，其实我也并不是喜欢胡枝子白花，

en.t: Chieko, to tell the truth, it is not that I particularly like white bush clover blossoms,

units.source_text: 任何一种花，每每由于赏花的时间和地点各异，人的感触也各有不同。”

en.t: with any kind of flower, people's feelings differ depending on the time and place in which they see it.
